overview: Build at full size, keep it as one block.

0.2.0: A miniature's item shows its own build, not the same little cottage for every one.
The bench is new: four planks, an iron nugget and a spyglass make a short worktable with a spyglass on an iron arm, unlocked by picking up a spyglass.

A functional block in the bench's own slot makes a miniature work as it: a crafting table, anvil, enchanting table, ender chest, chest, barrel, shulker box, furnace, smoker, blast furnace, brewing stand or jukebox. Storage built into the box is gone.
A miniature has a handle or a functional block, not both, and stepping into the box explains the handle.
Slab miniatures: half a block high, placed top or bottom like a slab.
Name a build as you finish it.
A miniature faces the way it was built, and sounds, breaks and wants the tool of what most of it is made of. The wrong tool is slow, never lost.
Copy a miniature at the bench, for the materials it took.
Sneak and right-click a miniature with an empty hand to build it full size where it stands: turned, mirrored or upside down if you like, with a preview of the space it needs.
0.1.1: No stepping into the workshop from a PvP Dimensions arena or the Learning Blocks classroom.
0.1.0: A bench that shrinks what you build into one block.
